#### Academy Awards

The eleven live-action films together have been nominated for 37 Academy Awards, of which they have won seven. The films were also awarded a total of three Special Achievement Awards. *The Empire Strikes Back* and *Return of the Jedi* received Special Achievement Awards for their visual effects,[165][166] and *Star Wars* received a Special Achievement Award for its alien, creature and robot voices.[167][168]
